exact_section: SPL document code34391-3 HUMAN PRESCRIPTION DRUG LABEL; active-ingredient and active-moiety identification; product evidence only, not an exhaustive federal-schedule search
memo_ko: 공식DailyMed SPL의문서분류HUMAN PRESCRIPTION DRUG LABEL과lisinopril제품을직접확인했다. MA94C§3(6)의ScheduleVI정의와함께처방약맥락을대조한다. 이단일label에DEA표시가없다는것만으로전체I–V부재를전수검증했다고주장하지않는다. 본문항은혈압치료·용량판단이아닌변경없는refill수신자의범위에한정된다.
